title: Anchorage logo mark
description: A small emblem beside a two-line lowercase wordmark, set tight in the display face, as the header and footer use it. The emblem can stand alone (footer).
notes: pass your own emblem (a lucide icon or an svg); leave lines empty for the emblem alone
name: anchorage-mark

props.name: emblem
props.description: the emblem, e.g. a lucide icon; drawn in the text colour

props.name: lines
props.description: the wordmark, one entry per line (e.g. ["strata", "reserve"]); empty for the emblem alone

props.name: label
props.description: the brand's name, read out by screen readers
